_comment: FALLBACK overrides for the narration register. Still a guess.
Spoken prose runs shorter and varies more than written prose, so mean_len
is capped low and cv_len expects real variation. fragment_rate is
deliberately absent: short fragments are a device here, and banding them
would flag the register's defining feature.
The `low` ceiling is raised to 1.5 rather than allowlisting conversational
intensifiers. A raised ceiling tolerates the register's ordinary rate while
still catching a genuine pile-up; an allowlist entry would hide the word at
any frequency. Same intent, and only one of them can still see.
